snippet.title: King of Tokyo - Richard Garfield: Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The iconic board game created by the legendary Richard Garfield makes its console debut!

In King of Tokyo, choose your monster, roll the dice, unleash destructive powers and crush your rivals in chaotic monster showdowns. Play solo against the AI or challenge your friends in intense local matches with up to 6 players. 

Buy the Limited Edition to get the full game and the official board game exclusive expansion including 1 Cardboard Figure + 1 BLOCKBUSTER BRO Monster Board + 8 Evolution Cards!

King of Tokyo: available now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam).
